【Important Before You Buy】1. Charge: Fully charge before first use. A full charge ≈7–8h (may vary). Use a 5V 1A charger or a computer USB port. Fast chargers may damage the keyboard. 2. Choose static over animated effects – animated RGB drains more battery. Press Fn+↓to dim/off, power off completely during long breaks. 3. Bluetooth Pairing: Toggle to [BT], hold FN+W (or E/R) for 3–5s until key flashes rapidly, then pair with [KN85 BT-1/2/3]. Bluetooth requires Windows 8 or later & Bluetooth 4.0–5.3
